evidence: Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and refactors ChainstateManager ownership specifically so kernel callers can use block storage independently of full chainstate.
rationale: Decoupling block storage ownership from ChainstateManager enables kernel callers to configure and inspect block storage independently. This addresses #35627 ('kernel: can't work with pruned blocksdir') and unblocks subsequent kernel pruning support in #36856.
